image.name: speedtest-tracker
image.description: [Speedtest-tracker](https://github.com/alexjustesen/speedtest-tracker) is a self-hosted internet performance tracking application that runs speedtest checks against Ookla's Speedtest service.

changelog.desc: Update nginx configs for v1.7.2. Existing users should update their nginx confs to avoid errors.
Cache Filament components and added APP_KEY as a required param.
Existing users should update their nginx confs to avoid http2 deprecation warnings.
Rebase to Alpine 3.19, upgrade to php 8.3.

env_vars.name: APP_KEY
env_vars.desc: App key used for encrypting stored data. You can generate a key as per [https://speedtest-tracker.dev](https://docs.speedtest-tracker.dev/getting-started/installation/using-docker-compose#install-with-docker-compose)

env_vars.name: APP_URL
env_vars.desc: The IP:port or URL your application will be accessed on (ie. `http://192.168.1.1:6875` or `https://bookstack.mydomain.com`

env_vars.name: DB_CONNECTION
env_vars.desc: Set the database type to use. `sqlite`, `pgsql`, or `mysql`

env_vars.name: SPEEDTEST_SCHEDULE
env_vars.desc: Set the test schedule in cron format. e.g. `0 */6 * * *`

env_vars.name: SPEEDTEST_SERVERS
env_vars.desc: A comma-separated list of server IDs to test against. Run `docker run -it --rm --entrypoint /bin/bash lscr.io/linuxserver/speedtest-tracker:latest list-servers` to get a list of nearby servers.

volumes.desc: Contains speedtest-tracker config and database, if using sqlite.

image.title: Speedtest-tracker
image.setup_instructions:
Access the web UI at `<your-ip>:80`, the default credentials are admin@example.com / password

For more information check out the [project documentation](https://docs.speedtest-tracker.dev/).

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  speedtest-tracker:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/speedtest-tracker:latest
    container_name: speedtest-tracker
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - APP_KEY=
      - APP_URL=
      - DB_CONNECTION=sqlite
      - SPEEDTEST_SCHEDULE=
      - SPEEDTEST_SERVERS=
      - DB_HOST= #optional
      - DB_PORT= #optional
      - DB_DATABASE= #optional
      - DB_USERNAME= #optional
      - DB_PASSWORD= #optional
      - DISPLAY_TIMEZONE=Etc/UTC #optional
      - PRUNE_RESULTS_OLDER_THAN=0 #optional
    volumes:
      - /path/to/speedtest-tracker/data:/config
    ports:
      - 80:80
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=speedtest-tracker \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -e APP_KEY= \
  -e APP_URL= \
  -e DB_CONNECTION=sqlite \
  -e SPEEDTEST_SCHEDULE= \
  -e SPEEDTEST_SERVERS= \
  -e DB_HOST= `#optional` \
  -e DB_PORT= `#optional` \
  -e DB_DATABASE= `#optional` \
  -e DB_USERNAME= `#optional` \
  -e DB_PASSWORD= `#optional` \
  -e DISPLAY_TIMEZONE=Etc/UTC `#optional` \
  -e PRUNE_RESULTS_OLDER_THAN=0 `#optional` \
  -p 80:80 \
  -v /path/to/speedtest-tracker/data:/config \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/speedtest-tracker:latest
